title: Characterization of proper polynomial factors
statement: Let $\ell$ be a positive integer, and let $m$ be a vector of $$-ary coefficients of length $\ell$. The finite search for a proper factor of the monic polynomial determined by $m$ returns true if and only if there are two vectors $a,b$ of $$-ary coefficients of length $\ell$ such that their associated low-degree polynomials are each different from $1$ and their product is the monic polynomial determined by $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a binary coefficient vector of length $\ell$
